scope: public Map, Database, shared record detail, imagery controls, and public graph

states.required_behavior: Show shell, release/profile context, accessible loading status; do not request device location.
Fail closed with release explanation and retry; never show stale data as current.
Preserve prior valid context while announcing the new query; map/list skeletons do not imply zero results.
Render bounded viewport results, clusters, synchronized list, visible count scope, and pagination affordance.
Render individual points and list rows without artificial density emphasis.
Use exact symbol, show exact display precision, allow eligible detail actions.
Use distinct area/halo symbol and persistent approximate-city label; no directions.
Keep record discoverable in list/database; never fabricate a point or cluster placement.
Open cluster summary showing total plus exact/approximate composition when known; do not select a random record.
Explain no eligible records in viewport and offer broaden/search actions; do not imply absence.
Debounce/cancel requests; keep old result set marked as previous context until replacement arrives.
Keep last valid results visibly scoped, show retry and query context, avoid silent fallback.
Keep list usable, show map limitation, offer accessible list/database path.
Show place/facility/source prompt and supported-field hint.
Do not issue one request per keystroke; preserve accessible combobox semantics.
Show bounded public suggestions with name/place/category/precision; keyboard navigable.
Say no eligible match in current scope and link to Database search; do not say facility does not exist.
Show retryable error and preserve query; do not clear user input.
Show active filter count and chips without occupying map.
Group controls, explain OR-within/AND-between semantics, provide Apply/Cancel on small screens.
Disable only affected facet, retain current selection, announce update.
Explain dimension unavailable in this release instead of hiding it.
Restore query/filter defaults, preserve explicit display preferences unless documented otherwise.
Show query bar, scope context, useful default columns, and no unexplained blank table.
Render semantic rows, stable sort, cursor status, and detail navigation.
State that only this page is loaded and more rows may exist; do not label complete.
Explain current release/profile/filter scope and missing-data limitation.
Keep current rows, disable duplicate navigation, announce page transition.
Say no further page in this query; do not equate with global completeness.
Retain query and filters with retry; never replace with an unscoped legacy list.
Show identity skeleton and route context; do not guess category or precision.
Show precise display state, provenance, eligible actions, and source limitations.
Show city-level limitation and no directions; keep record searchable.
Explain no publishable map point; show source/location fields only when eligible.
Show record type, provenance, graph connections, and canonical URL without inventing a map position.
Use generic safe not-available message; do not disclose whether suppression exists.
Show source name/status without inventing a URL.
Retryable error with back-to-results path and stable URL preserved.
Say no public connections returned under this release/profile; do not imply none exist.
Show source-supported connections and source context.
Show exact/high/medium/low bands separately; default order must not hide low confidence.
Retain and label contradictions; never collapse to a single asserted truth.
Show method, grouped signals, contradictions, source references, ruleset, observed/computed dates, and disclaimer.
Render bounded one-hop nodes/edges with selectable nodes and edges, canonical record navigation, and an equivalent keyboard edge list.
Keep the accessible edge list and record detail usable; never hide connections because the canvas renderer failed.
Keep facility evidence usable and label connections unavailable; no private fallback.
Development-only state; production build must not expose private graph route or pretend graph exists.
Summarize profile, release, filters, row bound, and visible/server scope before download.
Label visible-page/partial export and next-page availability in UI and file metadata.
Explain release/profile/rights/size blocker without downloading a broader set.
Provide accessible completion status and repeatable filename/context.
Keep selected state and offer retry; do not claim a file was created.
Copy only public route/query/filter/release/viewport state.
Announce success without exposing URL in analytics or adding private location.
Offer a selectable URL or browser-native alternative and retain state.
Expose stable metadata/JSON-LD/sitemap eligibility without leaking suppressed records or implying global completeness.
Show attribution and precision-safe vector basemap.
Show provider attribution, availability, licensing/cost disclosure, and retain exact/coarse semantics.
Keep vector map usable and explain that imagery is unavailable; never fabricate imagery or coordinates.
Show curated release context and its limitations.
Show separate profile context; never merge counts with official.
Show prominent persistent unreviewed warning before and during access; exclude from default curated totals.
Treat tips, evidence, facilities, and corrections as isolated untrusted submissions with moderation/provenance/privacy/abuse controls and no automatic promotion.
Suppress across map, list, detail, graph, export, cache, and history; generic safe messaging.
Do not render public fields or leak through counts, clusters, or error text.
All controls, rows, detail sections, map alternatives, and feedback reachable and announced.
No essential information depends on animated transitions or map movement.
No horizontal overflow; detail full-screen; filters sequential; list remains usable.
Content reflows and retains order/labels; map has a list alternative.
